coverageRationale.zh: 把 ISO/IEC 29192 的五类约束、安全强度/生日界公式、Part 2/3/4/5/6/7/8 的机制族与版本状态写成可复述框架；轻量不等于低安全，也不等于抗侧信道。
coverageRationale.en: Turns ISO/IEC 29192 into a reproducible framework: five constraints, security-strength/birthday-bound formulas, Part 2/3/4/5/6/7/8 mechanism families and status; lightweight is neither low security nor side-channel-proof.

zh.principle: **标准**：轻量级密码（Lightweight cryptography）。ISO/IEC 29192 是轻量级密码的“约束环境标准族”：芯片面积、能耗、代码/RAM、带宽、时延五类约束决定能否用；安全目标覆盖机密性、完整性、实体鉴别、数据源鉴别、不可否认与密钥交换。Part 1 给通用框架与安全强度量级；Part 2 分组、Part 3 流、Part 4 非对称、Part 5 杂凑、Part 6 MAC、Part 7 广播鉴别、Part 8 AE。
zh.why: 轻量不等于低安全：n 位安全强度的工作量约 2^n；n 位分组在单密钥下超过约 2^{n/2} 块，生日界开始削弱安全。选择机制要同时看安全强度、实现代价与协议约束；PRESENT/CLEFIA/LEA、Enocoro/Trivium、PHOTON/SPONGENT、LightMAC/Chaskey-12 各有面积、时延和模式差异。
zh.used: 物联网/RFID/传感器先列约束向量，再选部件：机密性用 Part 2/3，完整性用 Part 5/6，鉴别用 Part 4/7，AE 用 Part 8；最后按 Part 1 核安全强度。实现要固定参数（MAC 长度、counter 位数、nonce 规则）；同一密钥下换参数会破坏安全假设。
zh.broken: 常见错误：把“轻量”当“弱算法”、忽略生日界、在 AE 中重用 nonce、把 MAC 截断当可任意缩短、忽略侧信道。标准给机制与安全量级，不给具体硬件实现安全；Part 1 的约束清单不是认证清单。### 形式模型
zh.history:
Part 1 于 2012 发布、2025-12 发修订 1；Part 2 2019、Part 3 2012、Part 4 2013、Part 5 2016、Part 6 2019、Part 7 2019、Part 8 2022。截至 2026-11-24，Part 1 与 Part 6/7 已复审确认；Part 8 有在研修正案，不能把修正案当现行文本。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：轻量级密码的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 轻量级密码 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

**参数与状态规模**

公式 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\) 的输入、输出和单位必须逐项登记；复算顺序为：1. 读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数 2. 按标准表换算等效强度 3. 取最弱分量作为系统强度。

状态规模、密钥长度、分组长度和轮数决定复杂度；这些量不能从标题推断，必须以标准或实现文档为准。

**测试向量与实现边界**

标准测试向量只证明某组输入在某个实现中产生了预期输出，不证明所有参数都安全。记录测试向量时至少要写：算法/模式、密钥、明文或消息、随机数/IV、输出长度、实现版本。该条目已登记的限制是：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

如果实现使用查表、分支或可变时间操作，算法层的证明不能替代侧信道评估；如果协议层没有认证，算法层的机密性也不能阻止替换或重放。

**阅读路线与误用**

把 轻量级密码 当成“能加密”是不够的：要说明它接受什么输入、在什么假设下成立、输出交给谁。

常见误用包括把示例参数当唯一合法参数、把算法标准当实现认证、把一次测试向量当全参数证明。正文与计算记录要分别标明“来源事实”“形式模型”“未核空白”。

en.principle: **Standard**: Lightweight cryptography (轻量级密码). ISO/IEC 29192 is the constrained-environment family of lightweight cryptography: chip area, energy, code/RAM, bandwidth and latency decide whether a mechanism fits; security goals cover confidentiality, integrity, entity authentication, data-origin authentication, non-repudiation and key exchange. Part 1 gives the general framework and security-strength scale; Part 2 block, Part 3 stream, Part 4 asymmetric, Part 5 hash, Part 6 MAC, Part 7 broadcast authentication and Part 8 AE.
en.why:
Lightweight does not mean low security: security strength n costs about 2^n work; an n-bit block used beyond about 2^{n/2} blocks under one key loses birthday-bound security.

Mechanism selection must weigh security strength, implementation cost and protocol constraints; PRESENT/CLEFIA/LEA, Enocoro/Trivium, PHOTON/SPONGENT and LightMAC/Chaskey-12 differ in area, latency and mode.
en.used:
For IoT, RFID and sensors, list the constraint vector first, then select components: confidentiality from Parts 2/3, integrity from Parts 5/6, authentication from Parts 4/7, AE from Part 8; finally check strength against Part 1.

Fix parameters such as MAC length, counter bits and nonce rules; changing parameters under one key breaks the security assumptions.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
Common errors: treating “lightweight” as “weak”, ignoring the birthday bound, reusing an AE nonce, truncating a MAC arbitrarily, or ignoring side channels.

The standard gives mechanisms and security scales, not hardware implementation security; the Part 1 constraint list is not a certification checklist.

Conformance = Requirements ∧ TestVectors；Status ∈ {current, superseded, withdrawn}；Scope = (terms, requirements). Symbols are catalogue-level variables, not standard constants; parameters, test vectors and clauses remain with the registered source. The model states structural relations, not an implementation audit.
en.history:
Part 1 appeared in 2012 with Amendment 1 in 2025-12; Part 2 2019, Part 3 2012, Part 4 2013, Part 5 2016, Part 6 2019, Part 7 2019 and Part 8 2022.

As of 2026-11-24, Parts 1, 6 and 7 have been reviewed and confirmed; Part 8 has amendments under development, which must not be treated as the current text.
